benefits_en: Garlic has a substance called allicin which has strong power to kill bacteria and fungus, and to lower blood pressure and cholesterol.
benefits_sw: Kitunguu saumu kina kimelea cha allicin ambacho kina nguvu kubwa ya kuua bakteria, fangasi, na kushusha shinikizo la damu na lehemu (cholesterol).
medicinal_uses_en:
1. Internal Use (Eating/Drinking)
Lowering Blood Pressure, Cholesterol, and Boosting Immunity

What to do: Peel the garlic, then crush or chop 1 to 2 raw cloves. Leave them for 10 minutes before eating to activate allicin.

How to use: Swallow or eat together with food once a day in the morning or at night. You can swallow with a glass of water or honey to reduce the strong taste.

2. External Use (Applying)
Fungal Infections on Toes and Skin

What to do: Crush a few cloves to get the juice or mix with coconut oil.

How to use: Apply on the area with fungus once a day. Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes then wash well.
medicinal_uses_sw:
1. Matumizi ya Ndani (Kula/Kunywa)
Kushusha Presha, Cholesterol, na Kuimarisha Kinga:
Matumizi: Menya kitunguu saumu, kisha ponda au katekate punje 1 hadi 2 mbichi. Acha zikae kwa dakika 10 kabla ya kula ili kuanzisha allicin.
Mpangilio: Meza au kula pamoja na chakula mara 1 kwa siku asubuhi au usiku. Unaweza kumeza na glasi ya maji au asali ili kupunguza ukali.

2. Matumizi ya Nje (Kupaka)
Fangasi za Vidole vya Miguuni na Ngozi:
Matumizi: Ponda punje chache kupata uji uji wake au changanya na mafuta ya nazi.
Mpangilio: Paka kwenye eneo lenye fangasi mara 1 kwa siku. Acha kwa dakika 15â€“20 kisha uoshe vizuri.
precautions_en: Garlic reduces the ability of blood to clot. Do not use large amounts if you are about to have surgery or if you are using hospital medicines that thin the blood (blood thinners).
precautions_sw: Kitunguu saumu hupunguza uwezo wa damu kuganda. Usitumie kiasi kikubwa cha dawa kama unakaribia kufanyiwa upasuaji au unatumia dawa za hospitali za kulainisha damu (blood thinners).

benefits_en: Guava leaves are rich in antioxidants, vitamin C, and essential minerals that help fight stomach disorders, diabetes, and obesity.
benefits_sw: Majani ya mpera yana kiasi kikubwa cha vioksidishaji (antioxidants), vitamini C, na madini yanayosaidia kupambana na matatizo ya tumbo, kisukari, na uzito mkubwa.
medicinal_uses_en:
1. Internal Use (Drinking as Tea)

Diarrhea and Stomach Problems (Amoeba/Worms)
What to do: Boil 6 to 10 young guava leaves in 2 cups of water for 10 to 15 minutes. Strain it to get guava tea.
How to use: Drink 1 cup 2 to 3 times a day. Stop drinking when the diarrhea or stomach pain stops.

Lowering Blood Sugar (Type 2 Diabetes) and Weight Loss
What to do: Boil dry or fresh guava leaves (5 to 8 leaves) in a glass of water.
How to use: Drink 1 cup every day after the main meal (lunch or dinner). This tea stops the body from taking in too much sugar.

2. External Use (Cleaning and Applying)

Wounds, Skin Health, and Hair
What to do: Boil many guava leaves in water, then let the water cool until it is warm.
How to use: Wash wounds or rinse hair (it helps stop hair breakage and removes dandruff) 2 to 3 times a week.

Cough and Sore Throat
What to do: Boil young guava leaves.
How to use: Gargle when it is warm twice a day to kill bacteria in the throat and calm the cough.
medicinal_uses_sw:
1. Matumizi ya Ndani (Kunywa kama Chai)
Kuhara na Matatizo ya Tumbo (Amoeba/Minyoo):
Matumizi: Chemsha majani machanga ya mpera 6 hadi 10 kwenye vikombe 2 vya maji kwa dakika 10 hadi 15. Chuja kupata chai ya mpera.
Mpangilio: Kunywa kikombe 1 mara 2 hadi 3 kwa siku. Utaacha kunywa mara tu uharaji au maumivu ya tumbo yanapokoma.
Kushusha Sukari (Kisukari Aina ya 2) na Kupunguza Uzito:
Matumizi: Chemsha majani makavu au mabichi ya mpera (majani 5-8) kwenye glasi ya maji.
Mpangilio: Kunywa kikombe 1 kila siku baada ya chakula kikuu (cha mchana au jioni). Chai hii huzuia mwili kufyonza sukari ya ziada.
2. Matumizi ya Nje (Kusafisha na Kupaka)
Vidonda, Afya ya Ngozi na Nywele:
Matumizi: Chemsha majani mengi ya mpera kwenye maji, kisha acha maji hayo yapoe yawe ya vuguvugu.
Mpangilio: Osha vidonda au uoshee nywele (husaidia kuzuia nywele kukatika na kuondoa mba) mara 2 hadi 3 kwa wiki.
Kikohozi na Maumivu ya Koo:
Matumizi: Chemsha majani machanga ya mpera.
Mpangilio: Sukutua kooni (gargle) yakiwa ya vuguvugu mara 2 kwa siku ili kuua bakteria kooni na kutuliza kikohozi.
precautions_en: Guava leaf tea is safe for many people. But if you use too much of it, it can cause constipation (hard stool). Pregnant women are advised to talk to a doctor before they start using it every day.
precautions_sw: Chai ya mpera ni salama kwa watu wengi. Hata hivyo, ikitumiwa kwa kiasi kikubwa sana inaweza kusababisha choo kuwa kigumu (constipation). Wanawake wajawazito wanashauriwa kushauriana na daktari kabla ya kuanza kuitumia kila siku.

benefits_en: Neem (Azadirachta indica) possesses strong antibacterial, antifungal, and antiviral properties. The most commonly used parts of the plant are its leaves, bark, and seed oil.
benefits_sw: Mwarobaini una sifa kubwa ya kuua bakteria, fangasi, na virusi. Sehemu zinazotumika zaidi ni majani, gome, na mafuta ya mbegu zake.
medicinal_uses_en:
1. External Use (Skin, Mouth, and Hair)

Skin Conditions (Rashes, Fungal Infections, and Acne):
Directions: Crush fresh neem leaves into a fine paste, or use neem oil mixed with coconut oil.
Application: Apply the paste or oil to the affected area twice daily. Leave it on for 20â€“30 minutes, then rinse with lukewarm water. Continue until the skin condition improves.

Oral Health (Teeth and Gums):
Directions: Boil young neem twigs (used as natural chewing sticks) or neem leaves to prepare a mouth rinse.
Application: Rinse your mouth twice daily (morning and evening) after brushing your teeth to help reduce bad breath and prevent bleeding gums.

2. Internal Use (Oral Consumption)

Digestive Cleansing and Blood Sugar Management:
Directions: Boil 7â€“10 neem leaves in one and a half glasses of water for 5â€“10 minutes. Strain the liquid before use.
Dosage: Drink half a cup (50â€“100 ml) once daily in the morning before eating. Do not consume continuously for more than 7â€“10 days without professional medical advice.
medicinal_uses_sw:
1. Matumizi ya Nje (Ngozi, Kinywa na Nywele)
Magonjwa ya Ngozi (Upele, Fangasi, na Chunusi):
Matumizi: Twanga majani mabichi ya mwarobaini kuwa unga laini (paste) au tumia mafuta ya neem (neem oil) yaliyochanganywa na mafuta ya nazi.
Mpangilio: Paka kwenye eneo husika mara 2 kwa siku. Acha kwa dakika 20â€“30 kisha uoshe kwa maji ya vuguvugu hadi ngozi ipone.
Afya ya Kinywa (Meno na Fizi):
Matumizi: Chemsha mti mdogo wa mwarobaini (vijiti vya mswaki) au majani yake kupata maji ya kusukutua.
Mpangilio: Sukutua mdomoni mara 2 kwa siku (asubuhi na usiku) baada ya kupiga meno ili kuondoa harufu mbaya na kuzuia fizi kutoa damu.

2. Matumizi ya Ndani (Kunywa)
Kusafisha Tumbo na Kudhibiti Sukari:
Matumizi: Chemsha majani 7 hadi 10 ya mwarobaini kwenye glasi moja na nusu ya maji kwa dakika 5 hadi 10. Chuja maji hayo.
Mpangilio: Kunywa kikombe nusu (50ml hadi 100ml) mara 1 kwa siku, asubuhi kabla ya kula. Usinywe mfululizo kwa zaidi ya siku 7 hadi 10.
precautions_en: Neem is a potent medicinal plant and should be used with caution. Pregnant women should avoid using neem, especially internally, because some studies and traditional sources suggest it may increase the risk of pregnancy complications. Women who are breastfeeding or trying to conceive should also consult a healthcare professional before using neem, as its effects on fertility and breastfeeding have not been fully established. Prolonged or excessive internal use of neem may increase the risk of adverse effects, including potential liver and kidney toxicity. Always use neem in moderation and seek medical advice before using it for medicinal purposes.
precautions_sw: Mwarobaini una nguvu kubwa sana. Haupaswi kabisa kutumiwa na wanawake wajawazito (unasababisha kuharibika kwa mimba), wanaonyonyesha, au wanaotafuta mtoto (hupunguza nguvu ya mbegu za kiume na uwezo wa kushika mimba kwa muda). Matumizi ya muda mrefu yanadhuru ini na figo.

benefits_en: Moringa is known as the "miracle tree" because its leaves have almost all the important nutrients, vitamins, and minerals that the body needs in a day.
benefits_sw: Mlonge unajulikana kama "mti wa miujiza" kwa sababu majani yake yana karibu virutubisho vyote muhimu, vitamini, na madini yanayotakiwa na mwili kwa siku.
medicinal_uses_en:
Internal Use (Eating/Drinking)

Lowering Sugar, Blood Pressure, and Adding Nutrition

What to do: Use 1 small spoon of powder from dry moringa leaves. Mix it in warm water, soup, or sprinkle it on top of your food.

How to use: Use once a day for the first week. You can increase to 2 times a day depending on your needs.
medicinal_uses_sw:
Matumizi ya Ndani (Kula/Kunywa)

Kushusha Sukari, Presha, na Kuongeza Lishe:
Matumizi: Tumia kijiko 1 kidogo cha unga wa majani makavu ya mlonge. Changanya kwenye maji ya vuguvugu, supu, au nyunyizia juu ya chakula chako.
Mpangilio: Tumia mara 1 kwa siku kwa wiki ya kwanza. Unaweza kuongeza hadi mara 2 kwa siku kulingana na mahitaji yako.
precautions_en: Avoid eating the roots and bark of moringa completely if you are pregnant because they have chemicals that can cause miscarriage or make the womb contract.
precautions_sw: Epuka kabisa kula mizizi na magome ya mlonge kama wewe ni mjamzito kwani yana kemikali zinazoweza kusababisha mimba kutoka au mfuko wa uzazi kusinyaa.

benefits_en: Apart from its fruit being sweet, papaya seeds kill worms, and its leaves are used to increase blood platelets during high fevers like Dengue.
benefits_sw: Mbali na tunda lake kuwa tamu, mbegu za mpapai huua minyoo, na majani yake hutumika kuongeza chembe sahani za damu (platelets) wakati wa homa kali kama Dengue.
medicinal_uses_en:
Internal Use (Drinking/Eating)

Killing Stomach Worms (Seeds)

What to do: Dry papaya seeds then grind them into powder. Take 1 small spoon of that powder and mix it with 1 spoon of honey.

How to use: Eat in the morning on an empty stomach for 7 days in a row.

Dengue Fever and Increasing Platelets (Leaves)

What to do: Crush fresh papaya leaves then squeeze to get 1 to 2 spoons of its bitter juice (without boiling).

How to use: Drink 2 times a day for 3 to 5 days.
medicinal_uses_sw:
Matumizi ya Ndani (Kunywa/Kula)

Kuua Minyoo ya Tumbo (Mbegu):
Matumizi: Kausha mbegu za mpapai kisha zisage kuwa unga. Chukua kijiko 1 kidogo cha unga huo uchanganye na kijiko 1 cha asali.
Mpangilio: Kula asubuhi wakati tumbo likiwa tupu kwa muda wa siku 7 mfululizo.
Homa ya Dengue na Kuongeza Platelets (Majani):

Matumizi: Twanga majani mabichi ya mpapai kisha kamua kupata kijiko 1 hadi 2 vya chakula cha juisi yake chungu (bila kuchemsha).
Mpangilio: Kunywa mara 2 kwa siku kwa muda wa siku 3 hadi 5.
precautions_en: Papaya seeds should not be eaten in large amounts by men who are trying to have children because they have the ability to reduce sperm production for a while.
precautions_sw: Mbegu za mpapai zisiliwe kwa kiasi kikubwa na wanaume wanaotafuta watoto kwa sababu zina uwezo wa kupunguza uzalishaji wa mbegu za kiume kwa muda

benefits_en: This plant is very famous for problems of the breathing system, eye pressure (Glaucoma), and stomach problems.
benefits_sw: Mmea huu ni maarufu sana kwa matatizo ya mfumo wa upumuaji, presha ya macho (Glaucoma), na matatizo ya tumbo.
medicinal_uses_en:
1. Internal Use (Drinking)

Asthma, Cough, and Stomach Gas

What to do: Boil 3 to 5 fresh leaves in one glass of water for 5 to 7 minutes.

How to use: Drink half a cup (50ml to 100ml) 2 times a day until the symptoms reduce.

2. External Use (Drops)

Ear Pain

What to do: Crush a fresh leaf of mvuje, then squeeze 1 or 2 drops of its clean juice.

How to use: Drop into the painful ear once a day (make sure the eardrum is not broken).
medicinal_uses_sw:
1. Matumizi ya Ndani (Kunywa)
Pumu, Kikohozi, na Gesi Tumboni:

Matumizi: Chemsha majani 3 hadi 5 mabichi kwenye glasi moja ya maji kwa dakika 5 hadi 7.
Mpangilio: Kunywa kikombe nusu (50ml hadi 100ml) mara 2 kwa siku hadi dalili zitakapopungua.

2. Matumizi ya Nje (Matone)
Maumivu ya Masikio:

Matumizi: Ponda jani mbichi la mvuje, kisha kamua tone 1 au 2 la maji yake safi.
Mpangilio: Dondoshea kwenye sikio linalouma mara 1 kwa siku (hakikisha ngoma ya sikio haijapasuka).
precautions_en: Mvuje lowers blood pressure quickly. If you are already using hospital medicines to lower blood pressure, avoid using it without a doctor's advice.
precautions_sw: Mvuje hushusha shinikizo la damu kwa kasi. Kama tayari unatumia dawa za kushusha presha za hospitali, epuka kuutumia bila ushauri wa daktari.

benefits_en: Mkundekunde is a very important traditional medicine in Africa. It is used to clean and improve the reproductive system in both women and men, and also to treat stomach problems.
benefits_sw: Mkundekunde una sifa kubwa sana katika tiba za asili barani Afrika kwa ajili ya kusafisha na kuweka sawa mfumo wa uzazi kwa wanawake na wanaume, pamoja na kutibu changamoto za tumbo.
medicinal_uses_en:
1. Internal Use (Drinking)

Female Reproductive Problems (Opening the Fallopian Tubes, Cleaning the Uterus, and Helping Eggs Mature):

How to use: Take the roots of mkundekunde and wash them well to remove the soil. Then boil a small amount (about one handful) in 1.5 liters of water for 15 to 20 minutes.

What to do: Drink one cup of tea 3 times a day (morning, afternoon, and night) for 21 days continuously.

Advice on the schedule: For people trying to get pregnant, start drinking it on the first day of the menstrual period. After completing 21 days, stop using it and take a pregnancy test before starting another dose, to protect the safety of the pregnancy if it occurs.

Severe Menstrual Pain and Reproductive Problems:

How to use: Boil the roots or leaves of mkundekunde to make a drink.

What to do: Drink 1 cup in the morning and at night on an empty stomach during the time of pain.

Male Strength and Hernia (For Men):

How to use: Boil young mkundekunde leaves in clean water.

What to do: Drink 1 cup every night for 2 to 3 weeks continuously to reduce gas and increase body strength.

2. External Use (Applying/Bathing)

Removing Itching and Germs from the Skin:

How to use: Crush fresh mkundekunde leaves until they become a smooth paste.

What to do: Apply the paste to the itchy or affected area of the skin. Leave it for 20 minutes, then wash it with clean water.
medicinal_uses_sw:
1. Matumizi ya Ndani (Kunywa)
Matatizo ya Uzazi wa Mwanamke (Kuzibua Mirija, Kusafisha Kizazi, na Kukomaza Mayai):

Matumizi: Chukua mizizi ya mkundekunde, ioshe vizuri kuondoa udongo, kisha chemsha kiasi kidogo (kama kiganja kimoja) kwenye lita 1.5 za maji kwa dakika 15 hadi 20.

Mpangilio: Kunywa ujazo wa kikombe kimoja cha chai mara 3 kwa siku (asubuhi, mchana, na usiku) kwa muda wa siku 21 mfululizo.
Ushauri wa mpangilio: Kwa wanaotafuta ujauzito, anza kunywa siku ambayo hedhi inaanza. Ukimaliza siku 21, acha kutumia na pima ujauzito kabla ya kurudia dozi nyingine ili kulinda usalama wa kiumbe kikikaa.
Maumivu Makali ya Hedhi na Chango la Uzazi:
Matumizi: Chemsha mizizi au majani ya mkundekunde kupata supu yake.
Mpangilio: Kunywa kikombe 1 asubuhi na usiku tumbo likiwa tupu wakati wa kipindi cha maumivu.
Nguvu za Kiume na Ngiri (Kwa Wanaume):
Matumizi: Chemsha majani machanga ya mkundekunde kwenye maji safi.
Mpangilio: Kunywa kikombe 1 kila siku usiku kwa wiki 2 hadi 3 mfululizo ili kuondoa gesi na kuongeza nguvu za mwili.

2. Matumizi ya Nje (Kupaka/Kuoga)Kuondoa Miwasho na Vijidudu kwenye Ngozi:
Matumizi: Twanga majani mabichi ya mkundekunde hadi yawe ujiuji laini.
Mpangilio: Paka kwenye eneo la ngozi lenye muwasho au vijidudu, acha kwa dakika 20 kisha uoshe kwa maji safi
precautions_en: Mkundekunde (Wild Mkunde) should not be used by pregnant women because it may affect the muscles of the reproductive system and could cause pregnancy problems. It may also make you urinate more often.
precautions_sw: Mkundekunde (Mkunde Pori) haupaswi kabisa kutumiwa na wanawake wajawazito kwani una nguvu ya kusafisha na kusinyausha misuli ya mfumo wa uzazi, jambo linaloweza kusababisha mimba kutoka. Pia, matumizi yake yanaweza kukufanya uende haja ndogo mara nyingi zaidi, ambayo ni ishara kuwa mwili unatoa sumu.

benefits_en: Turmeric has great properties to reduce irritation and pain in the body (anti-inflammatory) and to protect cells from damage (antioxidant).
benefits_sw: Bizari manjano ina sifa kubwa ya kuondoa miwasho na maumivu mwilini (anti-inflammatory) na kulinda seli zisiathirike (antioxidant).
medicinal_uses_en:
1. Internal Use (Drinking)
Joint Pain (Arthritis) and Digestion

What to do: Take 1 small spoon of turmeric powder, mix it in a cup of hot water or warm milk. Secret: Add a little bit of black pepper to increase the body's absorption of turmeric by 2000%.

How to use: Drink 1 to 2 times a day, preferably after eating.

2. External Use (Applying)
Skin Glow, Wounds, and Pimples

What to do: Mix 1 spoon of turmeric powder with a little water or honey until it becomes a thick paste.

How to use: Apply on the face or on a clean wound. Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes then wash with warm water 3 times a week.
medicinal_uses_sw:
1. Matumizi ya Ndani (Kunywa)
Maumivu ya Viungo (Arthritis) na Usagaji Chakula:
Matumizi: Chukua kijiko 1 kidogo cha unga wa manjano, changanya kwenye kikombe cha maji ya moto au maziwa ya vuguvugu. Siri: Ongeza chembe kidogo ya pilipili manga (black pepper) ili kuongeza ufyonzwaji wa manjano mwilini kwa 2000%.
Mpangilio: Kunywa mara 1 hadi 2 kwa siku, ikiwezekana baada ya kula.

2. Matumizi ya Nje (Kupaka)
Mng'ao wa Ngozi, Vidonda, na Chunusi:
Matumizi: Changanya kijiko 1 cha unga wa manjano na maji kidogo au asali hadi kuwa uji mzito (paste).
Mpangilio: Paka usoni au kwenye jeraha safi. Acha kwa dakika 15-20 kisha uoshe kwa maji ya vuguvugu mara 3 kwa wiki.
precautions_en: Using too much by drinking can cause stomach upset or increase the risk of kidney stones.
precautions_sw: Matumizi makubwa sana ya kunywa yanaweza kusababisha tumbo kusokota au kuongeza hatari ya mawe kwenye figo (kidney stones).

benefits_en: Lemon grass helps to relax stomach muscles, reduce fever, and remove stress.
benefits_sw: Mchaichai husaidia kutuliza misuli ya tumbo, kushusha homa, na kuondoa msongo wa mawazo (stress).
medicinal_uses_en:
1. Internal Use (Drinking as Tea)
Fever, Stomach Problems, and Reducing Stress

What to do: Take 3 to 5 fresh or dry leaves, cut them and put them in one cup of very hot water. Cover for 10 minutes then strain.

How to use: Drink 1 cup 2 to 3 times a day (morning and night before sleeping).

2. External Use (Cleaning/Steaming)
High Fever and Strong Flu

What to do: Boil many lemon grass leaves in a big pot of water.

How to use: Cover yourself with a heavy sheet to breathe in the steam (steam inhalation) for 10 to 15 minutes at night before sleeping.
medicinal_uses_sw:
1. Matumizi ya Ndani (Kunywa kama Chai)
Homa, Changamoto za Tumbo, na Kupunguza Msongo:
Matumizi: Chukua majani 3 hadi 5 mabichi au makavu, yatekate na uyajaze kwenye kikombe kimoja cha maji ya moto sana. Funika kwa dakika 10 kisha chuja.
Mpangilio: Kunywa kikombe 1 mara 2 hadi 3 kwa siku (asubuhi na usiku kabla ya kulala).

2. Matumizi ya Nje (Kusafisha/Kujifusha)
Homa na Mafua makali:
Matumizi: Chemsha majani mengi ya mchaichai kwenye sufuria kubwa la maji.
Mpangilio: Jifunike na shuka zito ili kujifusha (steam inhalation) mvuke wake kwa dakika 10 hadi 15 usiku kabla ya kulala.
precautions_en: Lemon grass essential oil can burn the skin if not diluted well. It is not advised to drink this tea in very large amounts during pregnancy.
precautions_sw: Mafuta ya mchaichai (essential oil) yasipofutwa vizuri yanaweza kuunguza ngozi. Haishauriwi kunywa chai hii kwa kiasi kikubwa sana wakati wa ujauzito.

benefits_en: The uses of Aloe vera are divided into applying on the skin and drinking. To get safe results, it is important to follow the right amounts and timing.
benefits_sw: Matumizi ya Aloe vera yanagawanyika katika kupaka kwenye ngozi na kunywa. Ili kupata matokeo salama, ni muhimu kufuata vipimo na mpangilio maalum.
medicinal_uses_en:
1. External Use (Applying on Skin and Hair)
Small Wounds and Burns from Fire/Sun

What to do: Clean the wound, then apply enough fresh inner gel (after removing the outer skin and the yellow layer) to cover the whole area.

How to use: Apply several times a day until the wound heals.

Pimples, Dandruff, and Skin Irritation

What to do: Apply a thin layer of the gel on the affected area using clean cotton or fingers.

How to use: For pimples, apply several times a day. For dandruff, apply on the scalp 30 minutes before washing hair, several times a week.

Secret for effectiveness: Leave the gel on the skin for 15 to 30 minutes to absorb, then wash with clean water to prevent the skin from becoming too dry.

2. Internal Use (Drinking)
Heartburn and Stomach Ulcers

What to do: Drink fresh Aloe vera juice that has been filtered well to remove the chemical aloin (the yellow layer).

How to use: Drink once a day, mixed in a glass of warm water or other natural juice, 15 to 30 minutes before breakfast (on an empty stomach).

Constipation (Hard Stool)
What to do: Drink filtered Aloe vera juice at night before sleeping.

How to use: Drink at night to help soften stool in the morning. Do not use for a long time continuously.

Controlling Blood Sugar (Type 2 Diabetes)
What to do: Drink filtered Aloe vera juice.

How to use: Drink once a day in the morning.
medicinal_uses_sw:
1. Matumizi ya Nje (Kupaka kwenye Ngozi na Nywele)

Majeraha Madogo na Kuungua kwa Moto/Jua

Matumizi: Safisha jeraha, kisha paka kiasi cha kutosha cha jeli safi ya ndani (baada ya kuondoa gome la nje na utando wa njano) ili kufunika eneo lote.

Mpangilio: Paka mara kadhaa kwa siku hadi jeraha lipone.

Chunusi, Mba, na Muwasho wa Ngozi

Matumizi: Paka safu nyembamba ya jeli kwenye eneo husika kwa kutumia pamba safi au vidole.

Mpangilio: Kwa chunusi, paka mara kadhaa kwa siku. Kwa mba, paka kichwani dakika 30 kabla ya kuosha nywele, mara kadhaa kwa wiki.

Siri ya ufanisi: Iache ngozi ifyonze jeli kwa dakika 15 hadi 30 kisha uoshe kwa maji safi ili kuzuia ngozi kuwa kavu sana.

2. Matumizi ya Ndani (Kunywa)

Kiungulia na Vidonda vya Tumbo

Matumizi: Kunywa juisi safi ya Aloe vera iliyochujwa vizuri ili kuondoa kemikali ya aloin (utando wa njano).

Mpangilio: Kunywa mara 1 kwa siku, ikiwa imechanganywa kwenye glasi ya maji ya vuguvugu au juisi nyingine asili, dakika 15 hadi 30 kabla ya chakula cha asubuhi (tumbo likiwa tupu).

Kuvimbiwa (Kukosa Choo)

Matumizi: Kunywa juisi ya Aloe vera iliyochujwa wakati wa usiku kabla ya kulala.

Mpangilio: Kunywa usiku ili kusaidia kulainisha choo asubuhi. Usitumie kwa muda mrefu mfululizo.

Kudhibiti Sukari Kwenye Damu (Kisukari Aina ya 2)

Matumizi: Kunywa juisi ya Aloe vera iliyochujwa.

Mpangilio: Kunywa mara moja kwa siku asubuhi.
precautions_en: Using large amounts of Aloe vera juice per day is not advised without a doctor's supervision. Pregnant women (it can cause the womb to contract), breastfeeding mothers, and people with kidney problems or those using blood thinning medicines should not drink Aloe vera at all.
precautions_sw: Matumizi ya kiasi kikubwa cha juisi ya Aloe vera kwa siku hayashauriwi bila usimamizi wa daktari. Wanawake wajawazito (inaweza kusababisha mfuko wa uzazi kusinyaa), akina mama wanaonyonyesha, na watu wenye magonjwa ya figo au wanaotumia dawa za kuzuia damu kuganda hawapaswi kabisa kunywa Aloe vera.
